discardedCues.title: 1 · Start with fragment F1 in the assembled complex
discardedCues.body: The fragment screen finds F1 bound only to the KRAS–SOS1 complex. This small ligand is the first structural clue: it reveals an adjacent pocket that the inhibitor series has not reached.
discardedCues.detail: Historical input · PDB 6EPM/BQ5 · NMR fragment hit F1

decisionCard.title: Fragment screen
decisionCard.note: F1 supplies pocket information, not yet the desired inhibitory function.

discardedCues.title: 1 · The fragment opens the pocket—but stabilizes KRAS–SOS1
discardedCues.body: F1 stacks with Phe890 and contacts Tyr884 and Asp887. The open pocket is valuable, but Tyr884 remains compatible with KRAS Arg73, so the fragment strengthens the complex instead of disrupting it.
discardedCues.detail: Observed mechanism · Tyr884 remains KRAS-compatible · Phe890 is already out

decisionCard.title: Result · mechanistic clue
decisionCard.note: Keep the structural lesson; do not pretend F1 itself is already an inhibitor.

discardedCues.title: 2 · Bring in the independent inhibitor hit
discardedCues.body: A parallel three-million-compound HTS finds compound 1. Unlike F1, 5OVE/AXE disrupts KRAS–SOS1; this becomes the sole coordinate input for the prospective Agent API optimization branch.
discardedCues.detail: Parallel historical input · PDB 5OVE/AXE · prospective branch begins here

decisionCard.title: HTS branch
decisionCard.note: This is a second experimental starting point, not a crystal revealed after prediction.

discardedCues.title: 2 · Focus on why the second hit inhibits
discardedCues.body: Hold compound 1 and the KRAS Arg73 reference fixed, then move the camera only to the functional switch. The question is whether Tyr884 can still make its KRAS-compatible stacking contact.
discardedCues.detail: Mechanism comparison · 6EPM KRAS reference aligned to 5OVE SOS1

decisionCard.title: Mechanistic comparison
decisionCard.note: The zoom occurs at the causal residue and nowhere else in this beat.

discardedCues.title: 2 · Tyr884 moves away from KRAS
discardedCues.body: The ligand, peptide frame, and KRAS Arg73 reference stay fixed while Tyr884 moves from the F1-compatible state to the inhibitor-bound 5OVE state. That displacement weakens the interface that F1 had stabilized.
discardedCues.detail: Observed endpoints · Tyr884 OH displacement 1.38 Å after SOS1 alignment

discardedCues.title: 3 · Rewrite the inhibitor scaffold
discardedCues.body: The first graph rewrite preserves the hit-derived binding frame. Pose search and induced-fit relaxation are executed through the public Agent API, then the AWT state is frozen.
discardedCues.detail: Agent API · applyStep → pose.refine → pose.apply → optimization.run · freeze sequence 12

discardedCues.title: 3 · The first predicted pose lands
discardedCues.body: Only after the prediction is frozen does 5OVF appear. The scaffold-rewrite pose is recovered without fitting the ligand to the crystal.
discardedCues.detail: 5OVF opened after freeze · ligand RMSD 0.52 Å · Phe890 remains in

discardedCues.title: 4 · Merge the fragment lesson into the inhibitor
discardedCues.body: Compound 18 makes the substantial thiophene-linked growth suggested by superimposing compound 17 with F1. It starts from the preceding prediction, not from the newly revealed 5OVF coordinates.
discardedCues.detail: Agent API · predicted AWT becomes pose reference · AWZ freeze sequence 22

discardedCues.title: 4 · The first hybrid still leaves Phe890 in
discardedCues.body: The 5OVG evaluation confirms the retained Phe890 basin. Ligand placement is useful but not presented as atom-perfect.
discardedCues.detail: 5OVG opened after freeze · ligand RMSD 1.53 Å · predicted χ1 −73.4°, crystal −75.6°

discardedCues.title: 5 · Growth reaches the movable wall F1 revealed
discardedCues.body: Compound 21 adds the ring that reaches the Phe890 volume. Holding the original side chain fixed no longer gives a feasible continuation.
discardedCues.detail: Conserved-junction ring-axis sampling · twelve 30° ligand orientations

discardedCues.title: 5 · Test the conformational alternatives
discardedCues.body: The coupled search evaluates three Phe890 basins against the same ligand growth. Phe-in is infeasible at +4 new clashes; Phe-out adds 0; the +60° basin adds 2.
discardedCues.detail: Agent API · enumerateSidechainRotamers → applySidechainRotamer → updateReceptorReference → pose.refine

discardedCues.title: 5 · Predict the Phe890-out pocket seen with F1
discardedCues.body: The camera and ligand stay fixed while Phe890 moves from the inhibitor-series Phe-in basin into the selected Phe-out state. This prospective motion recovers the pocket state that the fragment screen had exposed.
discardedCues.detail: Predicted χ1 moves from −73° to −172° · no future receptor coordinates used

discardedCues.title: 5 · Freeze the open-pocket prediction
discardedCues.body: The selected Phe-out receptor and compound-21 ligand pose are serialized before 5OVH is accessible. The trajectory can now be evaluated without changing it.
discardedCues.detail: Agent API freeze sequence 78 · checkpoint 096e025eb610 · holdout still unopened

discardedCues.title: 5 · The crystal confirms the predicted pocket switch
discardedCues.body: 5OVH places Phe890 in the same outward basin. The ligand is not perfect, but the conformational event required by the design was predicted from the hit-derived trajectory.
discardedCues.detail: 5OVH opened after freeze · χ1 predicted −172.2°, crystal 175.8° · ligand RMSD 2.14 Å

discardedCues.title: 6 · Finish inside the predicted open pocket
discardedCues.body: BAY-293 is grown from the frozen compound-21 prediction. Its terminal aminomethyl group is placed without replacing the receptor by 5OVH.
discardedCues.detail: Agent API · applyStep → 64-chain pose refinement · predicted Phe-out state inherited

discardedCues.title: 6 · Freeze the final lead prediction
discardedCues.body: The complete BAY-293 ligand and pocket are hashed under the original 5OVE-only boundary before the final crystal is opened.
discardedCues.detail: Agent API freeze sequence 88 · checkpoint 19e82cebbddc · 5OVI still unopened

discardedCues.title: 6 · The BAY-293 pose is recovered
discardedCues.body: The post-freeze 5OVI crystal confirms the final ligand pose and the persistent Phe-out state. The hit-only trajectory ends in the reported chemical probe geometry.
discardedCues.detail: 5OVI opened after freeze · ligand RMSD 1.22 Å · χ1 predicted −172.4°, crystal −166.5°

discardedCues.title: Two starting discoveries converge on one successful inhibitor
discardedCues.body: F1 contributes the hidden-pocket and Phe890-out lesson; compound 1 contributes the Tyr884-displacing inhibitory mechanism. Four sequential Agent API steps then carry the inhibitor branch through the merge to BAY-293.
discardedCues.detail: F1 pocket clue + compound 1 inhibitor → 17 → 18 → 21 → BAY-293 · 21 nM

cues.title: 1 · Start from the hit—and change its scaffold
cues.body: Compound 1 in 5OVE is the only coordinate-bearing starting point. Its inhibitory Tyr884 arrangement is already present at time zero; no Tyr884 motion is claimed as a prediction.
cues.detail: Allowed input · PDB 5OVE/AXE only · future crystals unopened

decisionCard.title: Prospective boundary
decisionCard.note: The success claim begins from this hit PDB.

cues.title: 2 · Rewrite the scaffold
cues.body: The Agent API applies the scaffold rewrite, refines the pose, and freezes compound 17 while retaining the hit-derived binding frame.
cues.detail: Agent API · applyStep → pose.refine → pose.apply · freeze sequence 12

cues.title: 2 · The first pose lands
cues.body: Only after freezing the prediction is 5OVF opened. The scaffold-rewrite pose is recovered without fitting the ligand to the crystal.
cues.detail: Post-freeze 5OVF evaluation · ligand RMSD 0.52 Å · Phe890 remains in

cues.title: 3 · Merge a larger fragment
cues.body: A substantial thiophene-linked region is added to make compound 18. The frozen compound-17 prediction—not the newly revealed crystal—is the pose reference.
cues.detail: Agent API · predicted AWT reference · AWZ freeze sequence 22

cues.title: 3 · The pocket is still Phe890-in
cues.body: The 5OVG evaluation confirms that this hybrid still occupies the original Phe890 basin. The ligand placement is useful, but not presented as atom-perfect.
cues.detail: Post-freeze 5OVG · 1.53 Å ligand RMSD · χ1 predicted −73.4°, crystal −75.6°

cues.title: 4 · Growth reaches a movable wall
cues.body: Compound 21 reaches the Phe890 volume. Magenta collision markers show why continuing with the starting Phe890-in receptor is no longer feasible.
cues.detail: Coupled ligand/side-chain search · Phe-in adds four clashes

cues.title: 4 · Test the conformational alternatives
cues.body: Production rotamer search evaluates the same ligand against three Phe890 basins. Phe-in adds four clashes; Phe-out adds none and is selected.
cues.detail: Agent API · enumerateSidechainRotamers → applySidechainRotamer → updateReceptorReference → pose.refine

decisionCard.title: Phe890 branch search
decisionCard.note: This is the prospective conformational decision.

cues.title: 4 · Let the predicted pocket open
cues.body: The ligand and camera remain fixed while Phe890 alone rotates from the hit-derived in basin to the selected out basin. The gold side chain remains attached to its grey peptide context.
cues.detail: Predicted χ1: −73° → −172° · no future receptor coordinates used

cues.title: 4 · Freeze the open-pocket prediction
cues.body: Compound 21 and the selected Phe890-out receptor are serialized before 5OVH becomes accessible.
cues.detail: Agent API freeze sequence 78 · checkpoint 096e025eb610 · 5OVH unopened

cues.title: 4 · The crystal confirms the predicted switch
cues.body: The same locked camera cuts to 5OVH. The crystal places Phe890 in the outward basin predicted from the hit-only trajectory.
cues.detail: Post-freeze 5OVH · χ1 predicted −172.2°, crystal 175.8° · ligand RMSD 2.14 Å

cues.title: 5 · Finish inside the predicted open pocket
cues.body: BAY-293 is grown from the frozen compound-21 prediction. The final aminomethyl group is placed without replacing the receptor by 5OVH.
cues.detail: Agent API · applyStep → 64-chain pose refinement · predicted Phe890-out inherited

cues.title: 5 · Freeze the final lead prediction
cues.body: The complete BAY-293 ligand and its Phe890-out pocket are hashed under the original 5OVE-only boundary before the final crystal is opened.
cues.detail: Agent API freeze sequence 88 · checkpoint 19e82cebbddc · 5OVI unopened

cues.title: 5 · The final pose is recovered
cues.body: Without moving the camera, the frozen purple prediction cuts to the orange 5OVI crystal. The overall pose and Phe890-out state are recovered; remaining coordinate differences stay visible.
cues.detail: Post-freeze 5OVI · ligand RMSD 1.215 Å · Phe890 χ1 predicted −172.43°, crystal −166.55°

cues.title: A hit-only trajectory predicts the enabling change
cues.body: Starting from 5OVE/AXE, sequential Agent API edits reach compound 21, predict the Phe890-out pocket, and finish BAY-293. Later crystals evaluate—but never seed—the trajectory.
